advsec_get_alerts.description: Retrieve Advanced Security alerts for a repository. Results are scoped to the specified project and repository. Branch filters (onlyDefaultBranch, ref) apply only to code, dependency, and license alerts; they are not applicable to secret alerts and are ignored by the service, so they neither include nor exclude secrets. To narrow secret alerts by confidence, pass a single 'confidenceLevels' value ('High' or 'Other'); selecting every level is treated as no confidence filter.

Not applicable to secret alerts and ignored by this tool when alertType is 'Secret'. When alertType is unspecified, this filter is still sent and may exclude secret alerts from the results; query alertType 'Secret' separately to retrieve all secrets.

onlyDefaultBranch.description: For non-secret alerts: if true (the service default when omitted) only return alerts found on the default branch; if false, return alerts from all branches. Ignored when 'ref' is provided. Not applicable to secret alerts and ignored by this tool when alertType is 'Secret'. When alertType is unspecified, this filter is still sent and may exclude secret alerts from the results; query alertType 'Secret' separately to retrieve all secrets.

confidenceLevels.description: Only applicable to secret alerts. Accepted values are 'High' and 'Other'. Pass a single value (e.g. ['High']) to narrow secrets to that confidence level. Leave unset to return secrets without a confidence filter. Do not select both levels to widen results: the Alerts service does not accept a multi-value confidence filter and would return no alerts, so this tool treats an all-levels selection as no filter and omits it.

deleteSourceBranch.description: Delete source branch on autocomplete. Used for update.

transitionWorkItems.description: Transition work items on autocomplete. Used for update.

bypassPolicy.description: Explicitly bypass branch policies on autocomplete. Used for update and requires bypassReason when true.

bypassReason.description: Reason for bypassing branch policies. Used for update only when bypassPolicy is true.

reviewerIds.description: List of reviewer IDs. Required for update_reviewers.

reviewerAction.description: Whether to add or remove reviewers. Required for update_reviewers.

vote.description: The vote to cast. Required for vote.

repo_pull_request_thread_write.description: Write operations for pull request comment threads. Use the action parameter to specify the operation.

action.description: The action to perform. Options: create (create a new comment thread on a pull request), reply (reply to a comment in a thread), update (update an existing comment), update_status (update the status of a comment thread).

repositoryId.description: The ID or name of the repository. When using a name instead of a GUID, project must also be provided.

pullRequestId.description: The ID of the pull request.

project.description: Project ID or project name. Required when repositoryId is a name instead of a GUID.

threadId.description: The ID of the thread. Required for reply, update, and update_status.

commentId.description: The ID of the comment to update. Required for update.

content.description: The content of the comment. Required for create, reply, and update.

status.description: The thread status. Used for create (defaults to 'Active') and required for update_status.

filePath.description: The file path for the comment thread. Used for create.

fullResponse.description: Return full JSON response. Used for reply and update.

rightFileStartLine.description: Start line in the right file. Used for create.

rightFileStartOffset.description: Start character offset in the right file. Used for create.

rightFileEndLine.description: End line in the right file. Used for create.

rightFileEndOffset.description: End character offset in the right file. Used for create.

changeTrackingId.description: The file change tracking ID from the pull request iteration changes. Used for create.

firstComparingIteration.description: The iteration on the left side of the diff. Used for create.

secondComparingIteration.description: The iteration on the right side of the diff. Used for create.

wit_work_item.description: Retrieve work item data for a project. Use the action parameter to specify the operation.

action.description: The action to perform. Options: get (get a single work item by ID), get_batch (get multiple work items by IDs), list_comments (list comments on a work item), my (get work items relevant to the authenticated user), list_revisions (list revisions of a work item), list_for_iteration (list work items for a team iteration), get_type (get metadata for a work item type).

project.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps project. Reuse from prior context if already known. If not provided, a project selection prompt will be shown.

id.description: Work item ID. Required for: get.

ids.description: Work item IDs. Required for: get_batch.

workItemId.description: Work item ID. Required for: list_comments, list_revisions.

fields.description: Field names to include in the response. Used for: get, get_batch. For get, cannot be combined with expand.

asOf.description: Retrieve the work item as of a specific date. Used for: get.

expand.description: Expand options (None, Fields, Relations, Links, All). Used for: get, list_revisions. For get, cannot be combined with fields.

top.description: Maximum number of results to return. Used for: list_comments, my, list_revisions. Defaults vary by action.

includeCompleted.description: Include completed work items. Used for: my. Defaults to false.

type.description: Type of work items to retrieve. Used for: my. Defaults to 'assignedtome'.

skip.description: Number of results to skip for pagination. Used for: list_revisions.

team.description: Team name or ID. Used for: list_for_iteration.

workItemType.description: Work item type name. Required for: get_type.

wit_query.description: Retrieve work item query data for a project. Use the action parameter to specify the operation.

action.description: The action to perform. Options: get (get a query by ID or path), get_results (run a saved query and return results), wiql (execute an ad-hoc WIQL query).

project.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps project. Reuse from prior context if already known. If not provided, a project selection prompt will be shown.

query.description: The ID or path of the query. Required for: get.

expand.description: Expand parameter to include additional details. Used for: get.

depth.description: Depth of expansion. Used for: get. Defaults to 0.

includeDeleted.description: Include deleted items. Used for: get. Defaults to false.

useIsoDateFormat.description: Use ISO date format in the response. Used for: get. Defaults to false.

id.description: The ID of the saved query. Required for: get_results.

team.description: Team name or ID. Used for: get_results, wiql.

timePrecision.description: Include time precision in date fields. Used for: get_results, wiql.

top.description: Maximum number of results to return. Used for: get_results, wiql. Defaults to 50.

responseType.description: Response type: 'full' returns complete results (default), 'ids' returns only work item IDs. Used for: get_results.

wiql.description: The WIQL query string to execute. Required for: wiql. Example: "SELECT [System.Id] FROM WorkItems WHERE [System.TeamProject] = @project".

wit_backlog.description: Retrieve backlog data for a project and team. Use the action parameter to specify the operation.

action.description: The action to perform. Options: list (list backlog levels for a team), list_work_items (list work items in a specific backlog level), reorder (move work items to a new position in a backlog or iteration).

project.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps project. Reuse from prior context if already known. If not provided, a project selection prompt will be shown.

team.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps team. Reuse from prior context if already known. If not provided, a team selection prompt will be shown.

backlogId.description: The ID of the backlog category to retrieve work items from. Required for: list_work_items.

ids.description: The IDs of the work items to reorder. Required for: reorder.

previousId.description: The ID of the work item that should be before the reordered items. Use 0 to specify the beginning of the list. Optional for: reorder.

nextId.description: The ID of the work item that should be after the reordered items. Use 0 to specify the end of the list. Optional for: reorder.

parentId.description: The parent ID for all work items involved in the operation. Use 0 to indicate the items have no parent. Optional for: reorder.

iterationPath.description: The iteration path for the reorder operation. Used when reordering items in an iteration backlog. Optional for: reorder.

iterationId.description: The iteration ID. When provided, reorder items in that iteration instead of the team backlog. Used for: reorder.

wit_work_item_attachment.description: Download a work item attachment by its ID. By default returns the content as a base64-encoded resource. If savePath is provided, saves the file locally to that directory and returns the file path instead. Useful for viewing images (e.g. screenshots) or other files attached to work items such as bugs. If a project is not specified, you will be prompted to select one.

project.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps project. Reuse from prior context if already known. If not provided, a project selection prompt will be shown.

attachmentId.description: The GUID of the attachment. Found in the attachment URL: https://dev.azure.com/{org}/{project}/_apis/wit/attachments/{attachmentId}

fileName.description: The file name of the attachment, e.g. 'screenshot.png'. Used to determine the MIME type or the saved file's name.

savePath.description: Optional local directory path where the file should be saved. Must be a relative path (e.g. 'temp' or 'downloads/attachments'); absolute paths and path traversals are not allowed. If provided, saves the attachment to this directory and returns the file path. If omitted, returns the content as a base64-encoded resource.

wit_work_item_write.description: Write operations for work items. Use the action parameter to specify the operation.

action.description: The action to perform. Options: create (create a new work item), update (update fields on a single work item), update_batch (update multiple work items in one call), add_child (create child work items under a parent).

project.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps project. Reuse from prior context if already known. If not provided, a project selection prompt will be shown.

id.description: Work item ID to update. Required for: update.

workItemType.description: The type of work item. Required for: create, add_child.

format.description: Format for large text fields. Optional.

fields.description: Field values to set on the work item. Required for: create.

op.description: The operation to perform. Use 'test' with path '/rev' to enforce optimistic concurrency.

path.description: The path to operate on, e.g. '/fields/System.Title' or '/rev' for a revision test.

value.description: The operation value. Required for add, replace, and test; omit for remove. For a test on '/rev', pass the numeric revision previously read.

updates.description: Field updates for a single work item. Required for: update. For a safe read-modify-write, prepend a test operation on "/rev" with value set to the numeric revision returned by the preceding read; Azure DevOps rejects the entire update if the current revision differs.

id.description: The work item ID to update.

value.description: The new value for the field.

format.description: Format for large text fields. Optional.

batchUpdates.description: Updates for multiple work items. Required for: update_batch.

parentId.description: The ID of the parent work item. Required for: add_child.

title.description: The title of the child work item.

description.description: The description of the child work item.

format.description: Format for the description. Defaults to 'Markdown'.

areaPath.description: Optional area path for the child work item.

iterationPath.description: Optional iteration path for the child work item.

items.description: Child work items to create. Required for: add_child.

wit_work_item_comment_write.description: Write operations for work item comments. Use the action parameter to specify the operation.

action.description: The action to perform. Options: add (add a comment to a work item), update (update an existing comment on a work item).

project.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps project. Reuse from prior context if already known. If not provided, a project selection prompt will be shown.

workItemId.description: The ID of the work item. Required for: add, update.

text.description: The comment text. Required for: add, update.

commentId.description: The ID of the comment to update. Required for: update.

format.description: Format of the comment text. Optional, defaults to 'Markdown'.

wit_work_item_link_write.description: Write operations for work item links. Use the action parameter to specify the operation.

action.description: The action to perform. Options: link (link two work items together), unlink (remove links from a work item), link_to_pull_request (link a work item to a pull request), add_artifact_link (add a repository, branch, commit, or build artifact link to a work item).

project.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps project. Reuse from prior context if already known. If not provided, a project selection prompt will be shown.

id.description: The ID of the work item to update.

linkToId.description: The ID of the work item to link to. Required unless type is 'hyperlink'.

url.description: The URL for a hyperlink. Required when type is 'hyperlink'.

updates.description: Link operations to apply. Required for: link.

id.description: Work item ID to remove links from. Required for: unlink.

type.description: Link type to remove. Required for: unlink.

url.description: URL to match when removing a link. Used for: unlink. If not provided, all links of the specified type are removed.

projectId.description: The project ID (GUID). Required for: link_to_pull_request, and add_artifact_link (Git/Wiki types).

repositoryId.description: The repository ID. Required for: link_to_pull_request and add_artifact_link (Git types).

pullRequestId.description: The pull request ID. Required for: link_to_pull_request; used for: add_artifact_link (Pull Request type).

workItemId.description: The work item ID. Required for: link_to_pull_request, add_artifact_link.

pullRequestProjectId.description: Project ID containing the pull request. Used for: link_to_pull_request. Defaults to projectId.

artifactUri.description: The complete VSTFS URI of the artifact. Used for: add_artifact_link. If provided, individual component parameters are ignored.

branchName.description: The branch name. Used for: add_artifact_link (Branch type).

commitId.description: The commit SHA hash. Used for: add_artifact_link (Fixed in Commit type).

buildId.description: The build ID. Used for: add_artifact_link (Build, Found in build, Integrated in build types).

wikiId.description: The wiki ID (GUID). Used for: add_artifact_link (Wiki type).

pageId.description: The numeric wiki page ID. Used for: add_artifact_link (Wiki type). Takes precedence over pagePath.

pagePath.description: The full wiki page path. Used for: add_artifact_link (Wiki type) when pageId is not provided.

linkType.description: Type of artifact link. Used for: add_artifact_link. Defaults to 'Branch'.

comment.description: Comment to include with the artifact link. Used for: add_artifact_link.

wiki.description: Retrieve wiki data for an organization or project. Use the action parameter to specify the operation.

action.description: The action to perform. Options: list_wikis (list all wikis in an organization or project), get_wiki (get details of a specific wiki), list_pages (list pages in a wiki), get_page (get wiki page metadata without content), get_page_content (retrieve wiki page content).

wikiIdentifier.description: The unique identifier of the wiki. Required for get_wiki, list_pages, get_page, and get_page_content (unless url is provided).

project.description: The project name or ID. Required for list_pages and get_page. Optional for list_wikis, get_wiki, and get_page_content.

path.description: The path of the wiki page (e.g., '/Home' or '/Documentation/Setup'). Required for get_page. Optional for get_page_content.

url.description: The full URL of the wiki page. Used for get_page_content. If provided, wikiIdentifier, project, and path are ignored. Supported patterns: https://dev.azure.com/{org}/{project}/_wiki/wikis/{wikiIdentifier}?pagePath=%2FMy%20Page and https://dev.azure.com/{org}/{project}/_wiki/wikis/{wikiIdentifier}/{pageId}/Page-Title

top.description: The maximum number of pages to return. Used for list_pages. Defaults to 20.

continuationToken.description: Token for pagination to retrieve the next set of pages. Used for list_pages.

pageViewsForDays.description: Number of days to retrieve page views for. Used for list_pages. If not specified, page views are not included.

recursionLevel.description: Recursion level for subpages. Used for get_page. 'None' returns only the specified page. 'OneLevel' includes direct children. 'Full' includes all descendants.

wiki_upsert_page.description: Create or update a wiki page with content.

wikiIdentifier.description: The unique identifier or name of the wiki.

path.description: The path of the wiki page (e.g., '/Home' or '/Documentation/Setup').

content.description: The content of the wiki page in markdown format.

project.description: The project name or ID where the wiki is located. If not provided, the default project will be used.

etag.description: ETag for editing existing pages (optional, will be fetched if not provided).

branch.description: The branch name for the wiki repository. Defaults to 'wikiMaster' which is the default branch for Azure DevOps wikis.

testplan.description: Retrieve paginated test plan, suite, and case data for a project. Use the action parameter to specify the operation. When a response includes a continuationToken, pass it back with the same action and query parameters to fetch the next batch; null token indicates the last batch.

action.description: The action to perform. Options: list_plans (list test plans in a project), list_suites (list test suites under a test plan), list_cases (list test cases under a test suite).

project.description: The unique identifier (ID or name) of the Azure DevOps project.

filterActivePlans.description: Filter to include only active test plans. Used for: list_plans. Defaults to true.

includePlanDetails.description: Include detailed information about each test plan. Used for: list_plans.

planId.description: The ID of the test plan. Required for: list_suites, list_cases.

suiteId.description: The ID of the test suite. Required for: list_cases.

continuationToken.description: Token to continue fetching results from a previous request. Used for: list_plans, list_suites, list_cases.

testplan_test_plan_write.description: Write operations for test plans. Use the action parameter to specify the operation.

action.description: The action to perform. Options: create (create a new test plan).

project.description: The unique identifier (ID or name) of the Azure DevOps project.

name.description: The name of the test plan. Required for: create.

iteration.description: The iteration path for the test plan. Required for: create.

description.description: The description of the test plan. Used for: create.

startDate.description: The start date of the test plan. Used for: create.

endDate.description: The end date of the test plan. Used for: create.

areaPath.description: The area path for the test plan. Used for: create.

testplan_test_suite_write.description: Write operations for test suites. Use the action parameter to specify the operation.

action.description: The action to perform. Options: create (create a new test suite in a test plan), add_test_cases (add existing test cases to a test suite).

project.description: The unique identifier (ID or name) of the Azure DevOps project.

planId.description: The ID of the test plan. Required for: create, add_test_cases.

parentSuiteId.description: ID of the parent suite under which the new suite will be created. Required for: create.

name.description: Name of the child test suite. Required for: create.

suiteId.description: The ID of the test suite. Required for: add_test_cases.

testCaseIds.description: The ID(s) of the test case(s) to add. Required for: add_test_cases.

testplan_test_case_write.description: Write operations for test cases. Use the action parameter to specify the operation.

action.description: The action to perform. Options: create (create a new test case work item), update_steps (update steps on an existing test case).

project.description: The unique identifier (ID or name) of the Azure DevOps project. Required for: create.

title.description: The title of the test case. Required for: create.

priority.description: The priority of the test case. Used for: create.

areaPath.description: The area path for the test case. Used for: create.

iterationPath.description: The iteration path for the test case. Used for: create.

testsWorkItemId.description: Work item ID to set as a Microsoft.VSTS.Common.TestedBy-Reverse link. Used for: create.

id.description: The ID of the test case work item to update. Required for: update_steps.

steps.description:
The steps for the test case. Format each step as '1. Step one|Expected result one
2. Step two|Expected result two'. Use '|' as the delimiter between step and expected result. Required for: update_steps. Used for: create.
